clues.1: Where shadows gather near the highest wall, search beneath the cold stone to unearth your squad crest.
clues.2: Follow the silent corridor toward the mirrored hall. Look where stillness meets forgotten wood.
clues.3: In the chamber of silent tomes, seek beneath the lowermost shelf to recover your squad piece.
clues.4: Near the threshold where dusk breaks, examine the base of the sentinel pillar.
clues.5: Where two secret pathways converge, the relic shard rests hidden in plain sight.
clues.6: Look where the royal tapestry hangs. The secret passage conceals the hidden token.
clues.7: Search near the entrance archway, investigate beneath the shadowed stones.
clues.8: Behind the heavy drapery where the candlelight flickers upon forgotten iron.
clues.9: Seek beneath the wooden table in the quiet corner of the grand chamber.
clues.10: Find the hidden seal placed at the heart of the sentinel fireplace hearth.
